AI Video Discovery: one search, before you see anything

Send this to a volunteer BEFORE any rating packet, list of episodes or link to the catalog.

---

Before you rate anything, please write down one or two things you might genuinely want to
learn about from a technical podcast (software, AI, open source, product work, careers). Write
them the way you would type them into a search box, in your own words.

Please do not look at the project's episode list or repository first: the point is to have
searches that were not written with these episodes in mind.

1.

2. (optional)

For each one, if you like: who is it for (beginners, developers, managers, anyone), and how deep
should the answer be (introductory, intermediate, advanced, any)?

These searches are used to test whether the software finds relevant episodes. They are stored
without your name; you may later be asked to judge how relevant some episodes are to them.

---

Coordinator: add each search to benchmarks/datasets/relevance_v1/queries.jsonl with the next
free query id and "source": "blind_rater", before you send that volunteer any packet. Do not
edit the wording beyond fixing an obvious typo. Do not add or reword a query after seeing any
retrieval or recommendation output for it.
